incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: Trigger P22478 fired for service=runtime-proxy-prod — high 95th latency > 1200ms (4 triggers in 2m). https://pd.example/p/alerts/P22478

maria (oncall): acked. I'm on it. pinging jamal for infra checks. :wave:

jamal: thanks — I'm pulling the metrics now. any customer-facing reports?

maria (oncall): nothing in support queue yet, no elevated error-rate. just latency.

ops-bot: auto-suppress: detected duplicate alerts from same fingerprint; 3 duplicates suppressed (window=60s).
Suppress reason: repeated high-latency bursts on proxy frontends.

jamal: graph shows 95p spike coming from a small subset of pods in us-west-2, CPU jitter + request queue depth up. looks correlated with recent canary deploy at 08:17UTC.

patrick: can we confirm rollout? @maria do we have a canary that bumped traffic at 08:17?

maria (oncall): dm with deploy team: canary rollout started 08:15 and rolled back at ~08:19 automatically by rollout policy. might be transient.

jamal: quick mitigations: I'm scaling down the canary to 0 and rebalancing traffic. running:

```
kubectl -n prod scale deploy runtime-proxy-canary --replicas=0
kubectl rollout status deploy/runtime-proxy-canary -n prod
```

maria (oncall): done, canary scaled down. watching latency.

ops-bot: incident-bot: duplicate alert window increased to 90s for service=runtime-proxy-prod per oncall request.

jamal: latency 95p back to normal within ~40s of scale down. no 5xxs. here's a quick tail from proxy logs around spike:

```
[08:16:11] proxy-12 - warn - queue_depth=42 cpu=93% request_ms=1750
[08:16:12] proxy-12 - warn - shard_load=0.82
[08:16:13] proxy-12 - info - graceful_drop=true
```

patrick: looks like overload on a canary instance. good that rollout rollback worked.

maria (oncall): incident-bot: ack cleared by oncall. marking as no-customer-impact unless support sees anything. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: PagerDuty: Alert P22478 auto-resolved (all checks normal).

maria (oncall): handing off to jamal for postmortem follow-up — will add runbook tweak to suppress duplicate paging for repeated canary flaps and add a canary throttle. jamal — can you pick up? :pray:

jamal: taking. I'll open a short follow-up doc and propose changing the deploy policy to stop automatic network-shifts during canary. ETA 2 hrs.

patrick: +1 on runbook. maybe add a short cooldown before escalation.

maria (oncall): ok closing thread. no further action unless support pings. :smile:
